import re

def parse_grid(txt, label):
 m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n?)+)',txt)
 if not m: raise ValueError(label)
 h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2)); rows=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
 assert len(rows)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in rows), (label,h,w,len(rows),[len(r) for r in rows])
 return rows
pairs=[]
for s in msgs[1:]:
 gi=parse_grid(s,'input'); go=parse_grid(s,'output'); pairs.append((gi,go))
print([(len(a),len(a[0]),len(b),len(b[0])) for a,b in pairs])
